message: I've been spending more time with my grandkids lately, and it's reminded me of the joy in simple, low-tech activities. One thing we've been exploring is how to be prepared for anything that comes our way. There’s a wonderful resource out there that helps families create a safety plan together, making it a fun project rather than a chore. 🌼 Taking a little time to chat and prepare can turn into a bonding experience. What’s a fun way you’ve found to connect with your loved ones?
